listDescription: BMA enabling task catalogue — standardised task types with done-definitions and probabilistic duration standards. Duration standards are seeded from planner experience and updated monthly as real data accrues.

columns.description: Standardised name for this enabling task type — matches the BMA enabling task catalogue
Functional category for grouping and reporting
Department most commonly responsible for this task type
Median expected duration in days — 50% of tasks complete within this time. Seeded from planner experience; updated monthly from actuals.
80% of tasks complete within this duration. Use as planned duration for critical path tasks.
90% of tasks complete within this duration. Use as contingency planning value.
Number of actual task completions used to calculate the P50/P80/P90 estimates. 0 = planner estimate only, not yet validated by data.
Specific criteria that define when this task is considered complete — removes ambiguity at shift level
Planning considerations, typical predecessor tasks, common issues to watch for
Task types that typically must complete before this task can start (comma-separated)
Task types that typically cannot start until this task completes (comma-separated)
Set to false to retire a task type without deleting historical records
Date the P50/P80/P90 estimates were last reviewed and updated from actual data
